task.title: P6-144: Fix Undo last move bypassing pulls on_undo, leaving pick-list line stuck
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, ⌘K palette and quick-add). Original id: P6-144. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`⌘K → Undo last move` bypasses the pull's `on_undo`, so a pick-list line stays ticked and struck-through after the copies went back** (was `P6-030c`; `needs.rs:731-780`), and `toggle` (`:741`) then refuses to re-tick it. Self-clears only when the pick panel is closed.
